name: Redecilla del Camino (Spain)
description: Square yellow flag with a blue hoist stripe indented at its fly edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Redecilla del Camino (a font, a scallop, a tree and stars on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Redecilla del Camino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Redecilla del Camino arms — font, scallop, tree and stars on blue
